intro: Between April 13 and 29, 2026, ZCyberNews covered seven authentication-bypass incidents, with CVE-2026-41940 (CVSS 9.8) among the most critical. Other notable CVEs included CVE-2026-33413 (CVSS 8.8), CVE-2026-41276 (CVSS 8.1), CVE-2026-24032 (CVSS 7.3), and CVE-2026-1492. The affected sectors spanned technology, critical infrastructure, energy, enterprise IT, and finance, with a global impact. The severity mix comprised four critical, two high, and one medium severity vulnerabilities.
